title: Recording: Catman (The Rosies Are Coming), I Want My Love To Rest Tonight by Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono

Yoko Ono recorded two songs for her third album Approximately Infinite Universe on 23 October 1972, with John Lennon co-producing.

‘Catman (The Rosies Are Coming)’ was the first to be tackled, although it was re-recorded the following day. Mixing sessions for the song were on 5, 28, and 29 November.

‘I Want My Love To Rest Tonight’ was re-recorded on 26 October, and mixed on 5 and 11 November. However, strings were added on 20 November, and the song was finally mixed the following day.
